verdict.rationale: Outlook is an email service, not an agent, so whether it offers an official MCP server is a fair question for buyers. The pack documents no first-party Outlook MCP server: the Microsoft Graph mail APIs are developer building blocks, and one community user's unnamed 'MCP/cloud integration' is neither identified as official nor documented. Those adjacent items earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
